- [Reconciliation Walkthrough](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/disbursement-fee-report/reconciliation): This guide walks through how to reconcile your bank statement with your Disbursement & Fee Report (DFR).
- [Transaction Types](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/guides/disbursement-fee-report/transaction-types): This guide explains the types of records that appear in the Disbursement & Fee Report (DFR) and how each one affects your balances and investigations.
